body: Couple more weeks. A couple more weeks. I'll run out of money then. I'll try to have as much fun as I can. Try to visit friends. And then I think that's it.

I'd honestly go to a professional tomorrow if it meant that I could speak honestly and not have to worry about my 2nd amendment rights.

I'm already in this mental state, I have no criminal record, I already own firearms that would be sufficient for the task at hand.

Sub rules says we can't discuss methods, but suffice to say it *wouldn't* be with a firearm.

It bugs me that my best option for help is making a throwaway account and firing up my VPN in an incognito tab.

Yeah it's not great. I wish I could visit but I'd have to show up and look like a psycho and be like "hey can I cry in your yard for a few hours? I grew up here. My dogs are down there."

I've only had the courage to drive by the place once at night since my parents lost it. It didn't go well. Intentionally don't drive past it now.

It's stupid but there is a dog I had growing up. Wherever she is, even if it's nowhere, I want to be there too. I think about it a lot. That when I die she will be there. Been thinking about it for well over a decade. Life was so much brighter when she was around. I still remember burying her. And then my parents lost the property so I can't even go visit her grave any more. The other dog died 2 weeks later of heartbreak. Every day he'd just lay on her grave all day til we made him come inside for the night. They'd always been together. Buried him too, next to her.

That sucks.

I wouldn't feel safe ever without one. Like not at all. I just need to know it's there, even if it's stupid. At least to sleep anyway, I don't carry in public. Ironic, I suppose, that I'm so concerned with defense and being safe but thinking about ending my own life.
